metadata.scenario: A customer is disputing their latest invoice, which includes unexpected fees, and demands a detailed explanation. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi, Margaret. This is Dorothy Henderson. I'm calling about my latest invoice. There are some unexpected fees on it. I’m sorry to hear that, Dorothy. Let me take a look at your account. One moment, please. Okay, I have your invoice here. I see there are additional charges related to the physical therapy sessions. Can you tell me which fees you're disputing? Yes, it looks like I was charged for two extra therapy sessions that I never scheduled. I understand your concern. Let me verify the sessions on our end. Did you receive a call or reminder for those appointments? No, I didn't receive anything. I’ve only had my usual sessions. Thank you for that information. It seems there may have been a scheduling error. I will need to investigate this further. I appreciate that, but I need those charges reversed if I didn’t use the service. Absolutely, I will prioritize this. We want to ensure your billing is accurate. Can I confirm your last therapy session was two days ago? Yes, that’s correct. Great. I will follow up with our billing department and see if we can resolve this quickly. Thank you. I’d also like to know about the possibility of adding more personal care hours in the mornings. Sure! We can certainly look into increasing those hours for you. Would you prefer to discuss this while I’m checking on your billing issue? Yes, that would be helpful. Okay, I’ll note that down. How many additional hours are you considering for personal care assistance? I think I’d need about two more hours each week. Got it. I can have Lisa Chen, our Care Coordinator, reach out to you to discuss caregiver availability and scheduling. That sounds good, thank you. You’re welcome, Dorothy. I’ll follow up with you by the end of the day regarding the billing issue and have Lisa contact you about the care hours. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help. Of course! Thank you for your patience. Have a great day! You too, bye. Bye!
